_readme: MINIMAL JOURNEY — the smallest thing journey-runner.js will still run as a journey.
Reference example for skills/journey-proof.md; guided tour in skills/journey-examples.md.
Domain is invented (a purchase-request app) so nothing here is project-specific.
It asserts exactly two things: that the persona arrived on the list page (rung 1) and
that the page says what the requirement says it should say (rung 2).
IT IS NOT A VERIFIED MODULE, AND MUST NOT BE COPIED AS IF IT WERE. Rungs 3 (spans),
4 (data) and 5 (outcome) are absent. journey-proof.md is explicit that an absent rung
is `fault`, never `pass` — so a green run of this file means 'two rungs held', not
'the feature works'. --positive-control can only produce two of the seven mutants
from it (ui-landing and ui-text); the other five return false and are skipped.
Use full.journey.json as the copy-from template.
title: Purchase requests — the approver can open the request list
_personaWarning: VERIFIED IN journey-runner.js: `persona` is a LABEL, not a credential. The runner prints
it and copies it into the walk, but authenticates via H.login(page), which uses
cfg.user (env TEST_USER) and may silently fall back to cfg.fallbackUser. Set TEST_USER
to this account, or the report names a persona that never walked the app.
_seedNote: No seeds. Nothing in this journey substitutes a {{placeholder}}, so there is nothing to
bind. An empty seeds array resolves ok — that is NOT the same as a seed that returned
nothing, which makes the whole journey INVALID.

_readyNote: RUNG 1. A full CSS selector, not a bare widget name — the runner passes this string
straight to page.locator(). Contrast ui.checks below, which the runner wraps in
`.mx-name-`. Getting the two the wrong way round is the most common authoring error.
If this selector never appears the step is FAIL and every rung below it is recorded
INVALID rather than asserted against the previous page.
_textNote: RUNG 2. Matched against the whole rendered body text, case-sensitive, substring.
This is the only rung that can catch a screen that lies about correct data.
